authority_basis.summary: Figueiredo owns the flavor admission test; recording WP5 outcome and m=2 toggle map for ledger 1051.

operations.title: WP5 exact audit results: perfect matchings, determinant reality, gauge move, S3^3 transport
Second-harmonic toggle map results: tenth-edge probes on S38 and S43

Ledger 1051: matching-reality of det(YuYd) is a gaugeable presentation property, not a physical invariant; first-harmonic purity is a finer graph property than b1=1 (exact toggle map); flavor not admitted as a fourth Marici sector under the strong typing

Exact WP5 checker: per-sector perfect matchings equal determinants; phase-edge matching membership per chart; Example I gauge move Yu_12 -> Yu_22 makes det Yu, det Yd real with loop phase preserved; S3^3 transport preserves membership mechanically

Exact symbolic toggle map: add one real tenth edge at each zero of S38/S43; record whether the m=2 Fourier coefficient of det[Hu,Hd] stays identically zero; cross-checked by eps=0.9 FFT against 1e-8 noise floor

evidence.paraphrase: All four charts: unique matching per sector, signed sum equals determinant. S38 phase edge in the unique up matching (det ratio -1 as placed); S43/S48/S53 phase edges in no matching (ratio 1). Gauge move makes Example I determinants real, loop phase preserved at pi/2. Permutation transport (u,1,2)->(u,3,2) preserves membership True->True.

operations.outcome: All checks green: matching sums equal determinants exactly; matching-reality holds in canonical gauge except Example I, where an exact diagonal rephasing achieves it; membership transports under the texture groupoid

evidence.paraphrase: Baselines reproduce support {1}. S38: all five up-sector tenth edges break a2=0, all four down-sector additions preserve it. S43: five of nine additions break (u12,u21,u23,u32,d22), four keep (u31,d12,d21,d31). No m>=3 harmonic ever appears, even at b1=2.

operations.outcome: b1=2 is neither necessary nor sufficient for a second harmonic; the general graph criterion for first-harmonic purity remains open, now with an exact table; supersedes the epsilon-suppressed exploratory numeric probe that had suggested S43 was fully robust
